Joseph Banks was born on March 14, 2004, in British Columbia, Canada. He grew up in a small family with no siblings, and his parents divorced when he was eight years old.

Joseph's education began at the local elementary school, but due to his parents' divorce, he had to switch schools frequently until the age of twelve, when he started attending a private middle school in Vancouver. Unfortunately, there is no record of him attending high school or university.

In his early twenties, Joseph began working as an independent contractor for various companies, often taking on small projects and working remotely from home. He didn't have any formal job title but was known among his friends and acquaintances for being highly organized and adaptable in his work.

Joseph met his long-term partner, Emma, through a mutual friend at the age of twenty-five. They shared a love for urban sketching and gardening, and their relationship progressed slowly over several years, with both partners prioritizing open communication and shared interests. The couple lived together in a cozy apartment in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighborhood.

Joseph's artistic talents became apparent during his early twenties when he started posting his urban sketches on social media platforms under the handle "VancouverPencil." His scrapbooking hobby also brought him some local recognition, as he began selling his handmade journals at small art fairs around town.

In 2022, Joseph won an award for his contribution to Vancouver's urban sketching community through his Instagram account. He was recognized for his skill in capturing the city's architecture and hidden gems through his art.

Joseph is a self-proclaimed introvert who values his independence but also thrives on meaningful relationships with those close to him. Despite his reserved nature, he has built a loyal following among fellow artists and sketchers through his social media presence.

Some of Joseph's notable personal qualities include:

* Practicality: He always carries a small notebook with him wherever he goes.
* Adaptability: Joseph can quickly switch between different creative projects or adapt to new situations in his work life.
* Assertiveness: As an urban sketching artist, Joseph is confident and assertive in expressing himself through art.
* Introversion: While not shy, Joseph tends to prefer smaller gatherings and quieter social settings over loud parties and big crowds.

In his free time, Joseph enjoys practicing gardening and scrapbooking.
